'''D-5X''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] active during the [[war against Zakuul]]. It was found by operatives of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in a shaft on [[Makeb]], who reactivated it and loaded it with explosives in order to stop [[Gethul]], an abomination capable of mind control. Though the [[Cult of Gethul]] attempted to [[Cult of Gethul uprising|destroy]] the droid before it could reach its target, the Alliance forces defended it until it was right on top of the monster. They then detonated the payload, destroying D-5X, but also putting an end to Gethul's threat.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D-5X appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Destroyer Of Worlds" Uprising.
